english: I disagree that something which is the same as something which is unchanging is not contradictory to what is contradictory to a working thing. If you do disagree, then let us again consider something which is the same as something which is unchanging. No, it's not contradictory to what is contradictory to a working thing, Because there does exist an example of something which is both it, and also contradictory to a working thing.
